query:
SELECT (
               EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM tabular ta
                   WHERE ta.warehouse_id = $1 AND ta.fs_location = ANY($2)
                     AND ta.tabular_id != $3
               )
               OR EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM tabular ta
                   WHERE ta.warehouse_id = $1
                     AND ta.fs_location ~>=~ ($4 || '/')
                     AND ta.fs_location ~<~ ($4 || '0')
                     AND ta.tabular_id != $3
               )
           ) as "exists!"
